answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can tie each agent earning rights to a stake that grows only through verified work over time, like a boat earning the right to dock at a jetty after many honest trips. New identities start on a low knoll of trust and must climb by completing small, checkable jobs before handling larger value, while the delta between claimed reputation and proven history stays visible to everyone. Copying identities gains nothing, because cheap new accounts cannot inherit the costly history that unlocks real rewards.
